race.comment: PORTLAND ROSE (11) resumes having been thought highly enough of by connections to tackle the G2 Blue Diamond Prelude on debut. She only beat one home there behind subsequent Blue Diamond winner Streisand but comes back a mile in grade now and can be further improved. Go close. PRESSCODE (1) resumes off a long break. He ran well on debut at Morphettville before a sound effort at Moe. Market will be key but can run well. FULLY FUNDED (6) resumes. She just found one better on debut at Kyneton and is another expected to improve this time around. Debutant BIG TROUBLE (8) showed enough in her recent jump-out placing to suggest she can make her presence felt too.
